settings_navigation_identity_analysis.instances: SettingsView is instantiated from MainWindow.qml (node mode, pushed on nodeStack) and DesktopWallets.qml (desktop wallet mode, retained by settingsLoader after first use). In the failing interface_qml_node.py journey the GUI runs with -disablewallet, desktopWalletMode is false and DesktopWallets is never loaded, so exactly one SettingsView exists. Duplicate per-section PageStack instances named settingsNavigationStack_<section> exist inside one SettingsPageContainer (cached sections) and across the two mode instances in wallet journeys.
settings_navigation_identity_analysis.bridge_resolution: TestBridge::findObjectByName prefers visible QQuickItems, then visible QObjects, then objects declared inside a visible item, before falling back to the first match, so a retained hidden wallet-mode settings instance cannot be observed in place of the active one.
settings_navigation_identity_analysis.conclusion: The saved settle(stack_view_names=('mainPageStack', 'settingsNavigationStack_display')) barrier waits on the actual section stack whose push transition must complete before the language row click, and wait_for_page requires isVisible(). With one SettingsView in node mode the identity is unambiguous. The correction is validated empirically on Qt 6.10.2 and Qt 6.11.2 non-TSan runs; the original frontend-TSan journey remains the recorded failing profile and was not rerun on this host.
